supporting_observations.claim: At 13:40:29 UTC, the proxy recorded a successful request from ivy.chen's workstation for https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nwd-it/tools/main/u.ps1. The records establish the request and HTTP 200 status, but not the script's contents or whether it was run.

Shortly before the alerted activity, DC-NWD-01 recorded a Kerberos ticket request for sam.okafor from 10.40.10.21, and WS-SOKAFOR-01 recorded a network logon for sam.okafor from that same address. Other records identify 10.40.10.21 as WS-ICHEN-01's address; this is anomalous in light of the inventory's stated remote-administration practice, but the records do not establish what actions followed or link the logon to the script request.

known_telemetry_limitations: For the 13:40 request, the supplied proxy and connection records show the requested URL, status, and connection metadata, but do not provide the response body or a file hash (T033-00089, T033-00091, T033-00093).
The supplied evidence does not include a PowerShell process command line, script-block content, or a file-write or execution record that can be matched to this request.
claims_not_established: Whether u.ps1 contains malicious code or is an authorized internal script.
Whether the downloaded script was saved, opened, or executed, and whether it caused the reported PowerShell window to appear.
Who initiated the request and the preceding sam.okafor authentication activity, or whether those events are connected.
Whether the sam.okafor authentication from WS-ICHEN-01 was authorized.
additional_evidence_needed: Retrieve the response body or a trusted copy of u.ps1 and verify its hash, repository ownership, and commit history.

Collect endpoint process, PowerShell Operational/script-block, and file-system telemetry for WS-ICHEN-01 around 13:40 UTC to determine whether the script was saved or executed and by which process and user.
Investigate the sam.okafor authentication from 10.40.10.21, including session and process activity on WS-SOKAFOR-01, and ask the account owner whether it was authorized.
Obtain ivy.chen's account of the PowerShell window and any related action at that time.
unrelated_findings: Dropbox Update ran as SYSTEM on WS-ICHEN-01; Dropbox is an unapproved file-sharing service under the supplied inventory. Review separately (T033-00210, T033-00211, T033-00274, T033-00275).

Firefox on WS-ICHEN-01 opened the AWS console. AWS is not listed among approved services; review this access separately, without treating it as evidence that the alerted script activity was malicious (T033-00212, T033-00222, T033-00223).
